lines.text: David prays that God not be silent, because liars attack him without cause and accuse him though he is a man of prayer.
The prayer asks that a wicked man be set over him and a judge stand at his right hand.
The prayer asks that his days be few, his children be fatherless, and his descendants be cut off.
The prayer asks that the cursing he loved fall on him like a crown wrapped about him.
David will thank the LORD with his mouth in the presence of many, because the LORD stands at the right hand of the needy.
